description: This file defines interfaces and types related to D-Bus server objects, including mechanisms for handling method calls, signals, errors, and serial number generation within a D-Bus implementation.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Executes a method call with provided arguments, returning results or an error.

methods.name: NumArguments
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments the method expects.

methods.name: NumReturns
methods.description: Returns the number of return values the method provides.

methods.name: ArgumentValue
methods.description: Provides a representative value for a method argument at a given position.

methods.name: ReturnValue
methods.description: Provides a representative value for a method's return at a given position.

methods.name: DecodeArguments
methods.description: Decodes method arguments from a message, possibly using connection and sender info.

methods.name: DeliverSignal
methods.description: Delivers a signal to the appropriate channel or handler.

methods.name: AddSignal
methods.description: Adds a signal channel to the registrar for delivery.

methods.name: RemoveSignal
methods.description: Removes a signal channel from the registrar.

methods.name: DBusError
methods.description: Converts an object into a D-Bus error string and details.

methods.name: GetSerial
methods.description: Generates and returns a new serial number.

methods.name: RetireSerial
methods.description: Marks a serial number as retired or no longer in use.
